text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Reunion. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a woman, maybe 20s follows Yogi in — The Reunion still stands.
🛡️ The pantry holds about 2 days of food at the current burn — tribute takes 15,886 of 16,875 kcal and no more. What isn't paid rides as arrears; the village eats first.

🛡️ The watch looks at The Cancellation on the treeline — three dawns now — and looks away. Nobody fit to face it today.
